text_block_list.text:
Having wrapped up numerous races on this day,
I visited a certain traditional inn with Mayano Top Gun.
(—Patter-patter-patter!! Clatter!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya-chiiin, laaanding!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! Trainer-chan!
I've come to your room~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, don't talk like a teacher!
Say 'Welcome home, Maya♡' instead!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya was looking forward to going on
a hot spring trip forever and ever~!

“—Yes, this was a trip using the 'Hot Springs Ticket'
won previously in the shopping district lottery.”

Now that Mayano Top Gun has achieved her goal,
we came to the hot spring inn, knowing this was the perfect time to use it.

To heal our mutual exhaustion,
we decided to take it easy for once.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Still, why do we have to stay in separate rooms?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, aren't you lonely?
Don't you ever feel like being in a room alone sucks?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm... But still...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You can't have pillow fights or play cards alone, you know?
Are you really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
With Maya around, you can do anything, you know?
It might be 100 times more fun than being alone!

As Mayano Top Gun spoke, her whole expression
oozed with the vibe of wanting to play together—
choice_data_list: ...Shall we play for just a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I knew Trainer-chan
has way more fun when Maya is around!

"...Since I had the chance,
I decided to keep Mayano Top Gun company."

Before I knew it, night had completely fallen.
It was probably fine to head to the hot springs soon, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: *yaaaawn*...
Not having the heart to wake her up forcefully, I let Mayano Top Gun sleep in the room and decided to go to the hot springs by myself.
—Or so it seemed, however.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Trainer-chan,
don't leave me behind, nooo...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... Maya wants to go into the hot spring too~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: You're not gonna fall asleep halfway through, are you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: I'll wait till you're done, okay?
I'll wait until you're done, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Feh? Right here?
Trainer-chan, are you gonna stay the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So, as soon as Maya gets out of the bath,
can I see you right away, Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: We're gonna get to meet them!
We're gonna get to meet them!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! You definitely promise, right~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Trainer-chan,
you're just like Maya's dad~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Trainer-chan,
you're just like Maya's mom~
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fuhyaa~, this feels amazing!
My whole body is so nice and toasty!
choice_data_list: Looks like that woke you right up.
Seems like you're wide awake now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I feel like I've got a thousand times the energy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Trainer-chan.
They were selling ice cream over there!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Triple scoop ice cream! Triple!!
Maya wants vanilla, strawberry, and chocolate!
choice_data_list: Am I getting a little too energetic?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, hurry hurry, Trainer-chan~!
Mayachin, scramble~☆
Saying so, Mayano Top Gun dashed off toward the ice cream stand.

Even at the hot springs meant to soothe our exhaustion,
I predictably ended up getting dragged along at her pace, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"What flavor do you want, Trainer-chan~?
Let's share half-and-half with Maya!"

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Mayano Top Gun...
